name: pwm
title: Coal-PWM — PWM generator
description: Build a PWM generator with an 8-bit duty and 8-bit period. Output is high while the internal counter is below duty, else low. Testbench prints pwm:PASS.
context: Synchronous, posedge clk. counter counts 0..period-1 then wraps. pwm=1 when counter < duty. duty>=period -> always high; duty==0 -> always low. Testbench CHECKs: duty=0 -> pwm stays 0; duty=period -> pwm stays 1; for duty=period/2 the output has a roughly 50% high time over one period. print pwm:PASS.

manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input [7:0] duty, input [7:0] period, output reg pwm
manifest.behavior: duty=0 => pwm always 0; duty>=period => pwm always 1; duty=period/2 => ~50% high per period. print pwm:PASS.
